It currently plays in the [[2. Liga (Austria)|Second League]], the second tier of Austrian football. Since 2012, Liefering has been a [[reserve team]] for [[Austrian Football Bundesliga|Austrian Bundesliga]] side [[FC Red Bull Salzburg|Red Bull Salzburg]].{{Cite web |url=http://redbulls.com/soccer/salzburg/de/fc-liefering.html |title=FC Liefering Homepage |access-date=5 May 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131015102229/http://redbulls.com/soccer/salzburg/de/fc-liefering.html |archive-date=15 October 2013 |url-status=dead }} In December 2011, Red Bull Salzburg signed a cooperation with [[FC Pasching]] ([[Austrian Regional League Central|Regionalliga Mitte]]) and '''USK Anif''' (Regionalliga West). The coach of the Juniors, Gerald Baumgartner, left Salzburg and became new coach of FC Pasching. Also players went to Pasching and Anif. After the 2011–12 season, the new coach [[Peter Hyballa]] left the club and became new head coach of [[SK Sturm Graz]]. Liefering's ongoing presence in the [[Austrian Football First League|Erste Liga]] continues to create unrest, with average an attendance of under 500, many people believe the club is not good for the league. However the club promotes youth and has been a key factor in [[FC Red Bull Salzburg|Red Bull Salzburg]]'s 2016–17 [[UEFA Youth League]] side, who ultimately won the tournament."}}
